description: Compute stable binary cross entropy from logits and its derivative. Supply binary or soft targets in [0,1].
Fit continuous targets with unit-transition Huber loss. Clip the residual influence of large errors.
Use a smooth robust regression objective and its bounded influence function with scale one.
Train conditional quantiles with pinball loss. Supply a quantile between zero and one. Use zero subgradient at a tie.
Measure robust regression error in log space and compute its bounded tanh derivative.
Train a margin classifier with labels minus one or plus one and a squared margin deficit.
Fit nonnegative counts using a log-rate prediction. Returns Poisson NLL without the target-only factorial term and the log-rate gradient.
Downweight large regression residuals using a unit-scale Cauchy objective.
Train a pairwise ranker on preferred and rejected scores and return both gradients.
Train a row of logits against a normalized nonnegative target distribution. Return row cross entropy and its logit gradient.
Distil a teacher into student logits with temperature two and the temperature-squared loss convention.
Score binary probability calibration from logits with the Brier loss and its chain-rule gradient.
Compute smoothed soft Dice loss over a row and its probability-space gradient. Use targets and predictions in [0,1].
Train an embedding direction against a target row. A squared-norm epsilon stabilizes empty signal.
Advance weights and their velocity with classical momentum 0.9. Supply the learning rate as an input.
Advance a momentum buffer and apply the look-ahead gradient used by Nesterov SGD. Momentum is 0.9.
Accumulate squared gradients and normalize each parameter update by its own history.
Smooth squared gradients with decay 0.99 and update parameters with a scale-adjusted step.
Apply AdamW with decoupled decay, beta1=0.9 and beta2=0.999. Pass bias denominators 1-beta^step and nonnegative second moments.
Use a signed interpolated momentum update and decoupled weight decay. The persistent buffer uses beta2=0.99.
Track the maximum uncorrected second moment for AMSGrad and apply the bias-corrected step.
Track gradient and update energies for AdaDelta with decay 0.95. Return both histories for the next batch.
Scale each parameter row by a LARS trust ratio before an SGD step. Zero norms fall back to unit scaling.
Synchronize fast and slow weights at a caller-selected Lookahead boundary and measure the correction.
Apply row RMS normalization with per-feature gain and return the input gradient and per-row gain contribution.
Normalize each embedding row, add affine gain and bias, and propagate an upstream derivative. Sum gain contributions across rows externally.
Run a SwiGLU gate and return gradients to both halves of a transformer feed-forward projection.
Use a tanh-approximate GELU gate and propagate both value and gate derivatives.
Route feed-forward activations through a ReLU gate. At a zero gate choose the zero subgradient.
Rotate even and odd feature pairs with supplied sine and cosine tables and backpropagate to the input pair.
Normalize attention scores along each row and compute the softmax vector-Jacobian product.
Compute stable log probabilities and propagate an upstream derivative through row log-softmax.
Normalize only unmasked attention scores and propagate through allowed positions. Fully masked rows return zeros. Use a binary mask.
Fuse a residual addition with pre-normalization and return the combined residual stream and scaled output.
Normalize retrieval embeddings to near-unit length and differentiate a row objective through the normalization.
Apply a sigmoid gate and return both activation and gate gradients for a gated linear unit.
Clip each gradient row to a supplied positive L2 bound. Repeat the same bound across features in a row.
Subtract each filter row’s mean gradient and measure its remaining RMS magnitude.
Clip a gradient relative to the parameter-row norm. Supply a positive clipping factor fixed within the row.
Project one task gradient away from a conflicting task gradient. Output the projected gradient and original row dot product.
Merge two per-example mean gradients using their counts, then emit the merged mean and new count. Nonnegative counts are row constants.
Advance an exponential-moving-average teacher and track the mean squared gap from the current student. Decay lies in [0,1].
Simulate symmetric per-row INT8 weight quantization with nearest-even rounding. Return FP32 codes, reconstruction and scale for error analysis.
Simulate 8-bit asymmetric activation quantization with zero included in the range and integer zero point. Outputs use FP32 storage.
Compress a gradient to one sign and one row scale and carry the untransmitted residual to the next step.
Threshold small gradient coordinates and reconstruct retained signs with their mean absolute magnitude. Supply a nonnegative per-row threshold.
Ensemble two model distributions by a probability-space mixture. Supply a row-constant mixing weight in [0,1].
Apply classifier-free guidance and report the RMS size of the conditional correction relative to the unconditional prediction.
Compute the clipped PPO surrogate and clipping fraction using sampled-token log probabilities. Supply a fixed positive clip radius in each row.
Score a preferred/rejected response pair against a reference policy. Return the DPO loss and gradient to the policy log-ratio.
